rationale: The plan correctly identifies the repeated-measures structure and fits a single shared paired model (~subject + condition) with an omnibus LRT against ~subject plus all three pairwise Wald contrasts extracted from that one fit rather than from subset refits, which matches the reference closely. QC includes PCA/correlation colored by subject and condition and a defensible filter (count >=10 in >=4 samples, i.e., group size), with size factors and dispersion diagnostics kept inside the model, so normalization is handled properly. The main statistical gap is that no log fold-change shrinkage (ashr or equivalent) is specified anywhere, so reported effect sizes will be unshrunk despite BH at 0.05 being explicit. Enrichment is ORA on thresholded lists with a named collection but no stated universe/background, no collection version, no gene-set size window, and no ranking metric for the 'GSEA-style' option; the report also omits software versions and any explicit caveat about n=4 and the resulting low power.
